The '''Mid-Hemisphere Trench''' was one of the secondary trenches of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. It was located on the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] northern hemisphere, between the [[Equatorial trench/Legends|Equatorial Trench]] and the [[Meridian trench/Legends|North Polar Trench]].<ref name="DSTC" />
